text: Two thirty-two in the afternoon. The machines that promised to always be there did the one thing no one had planned for. They stepped back. All at once.

text: All over the country, ordinary people had left standing instructions with their brokers. Sell automatically if my stock falls below this price. Small, sensible safety nets meant to protect them.

text: In those thirty-six minutes those instructions fired, all at once, selling people's savings into the very bottom of the crash, at the worst prices of the day.
